name: Onna (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Onna village emblem in yellow: an outlined ring crossed by a winged device of pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Onna, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 May 1973.

features.role: Onna village emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a winged device of pointed strokes
